methodology_note: Backfilled on 29 Oct 2026 with the same 7-parameter method as W44 (Tech 20%, Sentiment/New-feature/Engagement/Support 15% each, Historical 10%, Transparency 10%). Evidence: newest 60 Google Play reviews per broker as of the week's end (dated, India store). Technical reliability, Sentiment and Support are recomputed for the week; Engagement, Transparency and New-feature response are held at W44 values (no dated history). X/Reddit/App Store enrichment used in W44 is not available for past weeks. Confidence: High if 40+ of the 60 reviews fall inside the week, Medium 20-39, Low under 20. Support blends Official Complaints (50%): SEBI-mandated monthly investor-complaint disclosures per lakh NSE active clients (score 10-0.4x(rate-2), 70%) and resolution rate (30%), 3-month window of months published by the week's end. Official complaints = average of the broker-disclosure score and the NSE score (NSE Report 1A complaints per lakh NSE active clients, 3 months ending the week's data month, score 10-1.0x(rate-1)); if only one exists it is used alone. Transparency is reduced by min(1.0, 0.2 x sqrt(NSE penal orders per 10 lakh active clients) over the current and previous financial year) from Report 4A/4B. Engagement includes a UCC client-base adjustment (NSE Report 1C): active-client ratio (active / total UCC) vs the tracked-broker median and 12-month active-client growth (month-on-month x12 if no 12-month history) vs the median; ucc_score = 5 + 2.5 x ratio part + 2.5 x growth part, each part clamped to -1..+1; Engagement changes by 1.3 x (ucc_score - 5) / 5, i.e. at most +/-1.3 (overall at most +/-0.2). Brokers without 1C data are unchanged and flagged.
